880-7201-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-7201-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2099-4131-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-4131-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

3967-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

4289-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
4289-4687-5296.description:
Activate Cryptolith Rite by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

618-728-3817.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

2738-4871-5075-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-851-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-4802.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-4802.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat.

129-1409-4785-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

465-670-1619-6141.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6141.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Displacer Beast.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Displacer Beast from exile to the battlefield.
When Displacer Beast enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Beast trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Displacer Beast.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

876-5614-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bighorner Rancher.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Bighorner Rancher.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Bighorner Rancher.
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Bighorner Rancher.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Bighorner Rancher.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Bighorner Rancher from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2232-5659-7435.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
2232-5659-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

3717-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Viridian Joiner.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

3967-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1491-4289-6218-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3259-3263-5953-7295.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-5953-7295.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5953-7295.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

791-3693-6581-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
Lightning has dealt combat damage to an opponent this turn.
791-3693-6581-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-3967-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-3967-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

2350-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2350-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

2034-5224-5705-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {2}. 
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marketback Walker, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

129-2464-3995.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
129-2464-3995.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-2464-3995.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

1778-3698-5220-6900.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Memnite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

4924-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

4616-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

560-2558-2829-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

372-2665-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Progenitor Mimic.
372-2665-4681.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Progenitor Mimic's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Progenitor Mimic leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Progenitor Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

252-1477-5394.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

440-1339-1874-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1874-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4089-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore do not have summoning sickness.
4089-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Glasspool Mimic.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Glasspool Mimic.
Activate Glasspool Mimic by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

4823-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Timeless Witness each turn.
4823-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

659-4381-4613-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-5223.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-4311-5078--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

1064-1242-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Born to Drive attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1064-1242-4702.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

280-1479-2292-5310.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering Bloodghast, Golgari Rot Farm, and Kodama.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Bloodghast enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Kodama's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering Bloodghast and Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

1874-2034-3490-3708.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1874-2034-3490-3708.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Wall of Limbs triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1462-5299.description:
All permanents become enchantment creatures with power and toughness equal to their mana value.
All permanents with a mana value of zero will be destroyed due to having zero toughness.

767-2011.notablePrerequisites:
You control four additional creatures.
All creatures you control do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
767-2011.description:
Declare Najeela and four other creature as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Druids' Repository triggers five times, putting five charge counters on it.
Activate Druids' Repository five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink, and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

874-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
874-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Delif's Cone enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
